title: A shoulder at the desk, from the lot
logline: The motel office through the glass door from the lot, at night: a shoulder in maroon at the desk's edge, the rest of him behind the doorframe. The sequence is nearly done narrowing; there's only a shoulder left to take away.

panels.composition: The motel office at night seen through the glass front door from the lot: a shoulder in a maroon polo at the desk's edge, the rest of the man hidden by the doorframe, the bell, the pad, the sodium light behind the viewer.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel office at night seen through its glass front door from the lot with only a shoulder in a maroon polo visible at the desk's edge, the rest hidden by the doorframe, a bell and a pad on the desk, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
